steps.name: sandbox-doctor
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "5cd0bbd81ca09fafbbcab5422b2b5010a1312692"
test -f /mnt/data/photomap-sandbox/env.sh
source /mnt/data/photomap-sandbox/env.sh
tools/sandbox/sandbox-doctor.sh
git diff --check
test -z "$(git status --short)"

verify_steps.name: frontend-focused
verify_steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
source /mnt/data/photomap-sandbox/env.sh
tools/sandbox/run-sandbox-check.sh frontend
git diff --check
test -z "$(git status --short)"

verify_steps.name: full-project-quality
verify_steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
source /mnt/data/photomap-sandbox/env.sh
tools/sandbox/run-sandbox-check.sh quality
git diff --check
test -z "$(git status --short)"
